title: The string quartet thesis

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: School days: grades, teachers and leaving school

blocks.x: Since we’re talking about Kermit and the quartet and the… that was done… that was a composition in your Institute of Music days, right? Was that your thesis there or…?
I don’t… it might have been. I don’t think so because there was no guitar originally in that… that was my… when I was in music school. It was a string quartet.

Yeah. And I… the first movement’s not too bad, and then I was running out of time and I needed to graduate, so I quickly scribbled off two more movements. And then, I have opened it up a couple times and added a guitar solo in a part so…
